15. (Currently amended) A method for selecting a first server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising:
accessing a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers;
adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is added to the locator as a unique signature included in a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the unique signature identifying a media request__; and
selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator __in response to an http request generated by a web browser from selection of the hyperlink by the client computer, the http request containing the unique signature__.

16.
